questions.question_text: Natural camphor is:

options.A: An optically inactive aldehyde obtained from cinnamomum camphora
options.B: A white dextrorotatory ketone obtained from the wood of cinnamomum camphora
options.C: A white optically inactive ketone obtained form the bark of cinnamomum camphora
options.D: A white volatile aldehyde obtained from the bark of cinnamomum camphora

questions.explanation: Natural camphor is a white, dextrorotatory cyclic terpene ketone derived from the wood of Cinnamomum camphora.

questions.question_text: Ingredients used for capsulation in soft capsule should flow by gravity at a temperature Not exceeding
questions.explanation: Liquid or paste fill formulations for soft gelatin capsules must flow by gravity at temperatures not exceeding $35^\circ\text{C}$ to avoid damaging the gelatin shell.

questions.question_text: The region of the electromagnetic spectrum below $200\text{ nm}$ is known as
questions.explanation: Electromagnetic radiation below $200\text{ nm}$ is absorbed by atmospheric oxygen, necessitating a vacuum for spectrophotometric measurements, hence termed vacuum ultraviolet.

questions.explanation: Microemulsions are thermodynamically stable, isotropic systems that appear transparent or translucent due to droplet sizes typically under $100\text{ nm}$.

questions.question_text: Which of the following steroids shows predominant mineralocorticoid action?
questions.explanation: Fludrocortisone is a potent synthetic corticosteroid with exceptionally high mineralocorticoid activity relative to its glucocorticoid effect.

questions.question_text: The factors affecting diffusion current in polarography can be denoted by
questions.explanation: The Ilkovic equation relates the diffusion current to the concentration of the electroactive species in polarography.

questions.question_text: Rotosort is an equipment used

options.B: To fix the cap and body of the capsules after filling
options.D: To adjust the required compression for the tablets

questions.explanation: Rotosort is a machine specifically designed for sorting and separating defective or improper tablets from a batch.

questions.question_text: As per G.M.P. permitted limit of slid contents in water for injection is:
questions.explanation: Water for injection must be purified stringently, maintaining very low total solids, typically adhering to limits such as $0.1\text{ ppm}$ or strict conductivity limits.

questions.question_text: Nujol is
questions.explanation: Nujol is a heavy mineral oil commonly used as a mulling agent in infrared spectroscopy.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a microsomal enzyme inducer?
questions.explanation: Glutethamide is a well-known hepatic microsomal enzyme inducer that accelerates the metabolism of various drugs.

questions.question_text: Fiducial limit is a term used in
questions.explanation: Fiducial limits (confidence limits) are commonly applied in biological assays to express the precision and reliability of potency estimations.

questions.question_text: Phenothiazines are metabolized

options.A: In the hepatic microsomal system by hydroxylation followed by conjugation with glucuronicad
options.C: In the hepatic microsomal system by reduction
options.D: In the hepatic microsomal system by oxidation followed by conjugation withy glycine.

questions.explanation: Phenothiazines undergo extensive hepatic metabolism primarily via aromatic hydroxylation and subsequent conjugation with glucuronic acid.

questions.question_text: Benzodiazepines potentiate

options.A: The binding of protein to nervous tissue
options.B: The binding of GABA to liver
options.C: The binding of GABA to receptors
options.D: The binding or GABA to carbohydrates

questions.explanation: Benzodiazepines allosterically bind to $\text{GABA}_\text{A}$ receptors, enhancing the affinity and frequency of GABA binding and chloride channel opening.

questions.question_text: Benzalkonium chloride is a germicidal surfactant which is rendered inactive in the presence of
questions.explanation: Benzalkonium chloride is a cationic surfactant that forms inactive complexes in the presence of anionic surfactants such as soaps.

questions.question_text: Enkephalins are

options.B: Endogenous ligands which are pentapeptides that are localized in some nerve endings.
options.C: Endogenous ligands which are tripeptides that are present in nervous tissue
options.D: Endogenous ligands which are tetrapeptides that are present in cardiovascular tissue.

questions.explanation: Enkephalins are endogenous opioid pentapeptides involved in regulating nociception, localized at nerve terminals.

questions.question_text: Benorylate is a Prodrug, chemically it is polymeric condensation product of

options.B: An acetyl salicylic ester of phenol
options.C: An acetyl salicylic ester of paracetamol

questions.explanation: Benorylate is an ester prodrug formed by combining aspirin (acetylsalicylic acid) and paracetamol.

questions.question_text: Listed below are some of the common vehicles, which one is most appropriate for the intravenous admixture of ampicillin $500\text{ mg}/50\text{ ml}$?
questions.explanation: Ampicillin sodium solutions have limited stability in dextrose solutions due to rapid degradation, making normal saline ($0.9\%$ NaCl) the preferred vehicle.

questions.question_text: Acetonides are prepared to improve the bioavailability of certain drugs. Which of the following is available as acetonide?
questions.explanation: Triamcinolone acetonide is a potent synthetic corticosteroid acetonide derivative designed for enhanced lipophilicity and topical/systemic efficacy.

questions.question_text: Which one of the following indicators is used in Complexometric Titration?
questions.explanation: Murexide is a classic metallochromic indicator frequently used in complexometric titrations, especially for calcium estimation.

questions.question_text: Betamethasone is:

options.A: $9\alpha$ Fluro $11\beta, 17\alpha, 21$ trihydroxy $16\beta$ methyl pregna-$1, 4$ diene $3, 20$ dione
options.B: $9\alpha$ Fluro $12\beta, 13\alpha, 21$ trihydroxy $17\beta$ methyl estra-$1, 4$ diene $3, 20$ diene
options.C: $9\alpha$ Fluro $11\beta, 17\alpha, 21$ trihydroxy $16\beta$ methyl estra-$1, 4$ diene $3, 20$ dione
options.D: $9\alpha$ Fluro $11\beta, 17\alpha$, dihydroxy $16\beta$ methyl pregna-$1, 4$ diene $3, 20$ dione

questions.explanation: Betamethasone IUPAC nomenclature specifies a pregnadiene core with $9\alpha$-fluoro, $11\beta, 17\alpha, 21$-trihydroxy, and $16\beta$-methyl substituents.
